description: This Java class 'SafeRecovery' is a utility wrapper for Akka's ReceiveBuilder, designed to create a recovery message handler that logs exceptions instead of throwing them, thus ensuring recovery process robustness.

classes.name: SafeRecovery
classes.description: A utility class providing a method to generate a safe, exception-logging version of Akka Actor's Receive for recovery purposes.

methods.name: wrapReceive
methods.description: Creates an Akka Receive that wraps around existing receive logic to catch exceptions, log warnings if a logger is provided, and prevent exceptions from propagating during recovery.
